planets.name: HIP 116454 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of HIP 116454 with a 9.1-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: HIP 116454 b was found in 2014 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around HIP 116454. Its orbit and size follow Thygesen et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname THYGESEN_ET_AL__2024): disc_year 2014, disc_facility K2, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 9.1004157, pl_radj 0.22026981, pl_bmassj 0.03051961

quotes.title: HIP 116454 b
quotes.card: HIP 116454 b, or K2-2 b, is an exoplanet orbiting the star HIP 116454, 62 parsecs (201 ly) from Earth toward the constellation Pisces.
quotes.introduction: It is 32,000 kilometres (20,000 mi) in diameter and 12 times as massive as Earth.
